title: 500 fishers in Ilocos Sur receive P10,000 livelihood aid
summary: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Five hundred fishers from 13 barangays in Cabugao, Ilocos Sur, each received P10,000 in additional livelihood capital from the Department of Social Welfare…

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Five hundred fishers from 13 barangays in Cabugao, Ilocos Sur, each received P10,000 in additional livelihood capital from the Department of Social Welfare and Development Field Office 1 (DSWD FO 1) on Monday, Sept. 14. The assistance was provided through the agency’s Sustainable Livelihood Program (SLP) as part of the government’s “Handog ng Pangulo: Serbisyong Sapat Para sa Lahat” initiative.
